items: Completed — Background changed to dark blue.

Completed — Local answer. Phishing uses deceptive messages to get people to share information or take unsafe actions. Check the full sender address, unexpected urgency and whether the request matches what you know. A familiar logo or a padlock alone cannot establish trust. Practical steps: Open the service through a saved bookmark, verify the request through a trusted contact, and report the message. This explanation uses general cybersecurity knowledge.

name: Contextual comparison
actual: Local answer. DDoS disrupts availability by overwhelming a service. Phishing uses a deceptive message to persuade a person to share information or take an unsafe action. DDoS Guard AI in Assignment 7 demonstrates flow analysis for the first problem. Practical steps: compare traffic against its baseline for DDoS and verify the sender independently for phishing.
